description: A Location represents a geographic location. The location may be described as any, some or all of the following: region (e.g., North America), civic address (e.g. New York, US), latitude and longitude. Clusters imported from STIX Location objects. Each cluster keeps the STIX version of the object it comes from (2.0, 2.1, ...) in its `spec_version` meta field.
name: STIX Location
